decision: Keep the conditional arithmetic experiment isolated. At 256 groups, original/inline/prepared medians are 0.3743/3.1462/0.9460 ms, before the separately measured 5.8371 ms preparation cost. Reducing matrix count does not offset encoding and reconstruction work. No full-QK integration or product performance claim follows.
implementation: The H7 domain has magnitude at most32640 and at most eight significant bits, exactly encodable in FP16. One zero-C FP16 matrix estimates a full dot with maximum mathematical magnitude17045913600. Two unsigned IU8 matrices supply residues modulo255 and256. Their coprime product65280 identifies the unique nearest congruent integer whenever the estimate has error below32640. The observed pair-model recurrence conditionally bounds H7 error by3920. Recovery uses signed int64 arithmetic, signed byte folding modulo255, explicit tie rejection and full-dot range checks. A prepared row contains32 bytes of FP16 values plus16 bytes for each residue. Original four-IU832-byte rows remain the independent native control.
